descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Melbourne puts you in the captain's seat over the real Melbourne.

THE REAL MELBOURNE
Eureka Tower's gold crown, Australia 108, the Rialto, Collins Street, Flinders Street Station, Federation Square, St Paul's, the Arts Centre spire, the Shrine of Remembrance, the Royal Exhibition Building, the State Library and Parliament House.

THE BIG GAME
The MCG and its light towers, Rod Laver Arena, AAMI Park and Marvel Stadium.

THE RIVER AND THE BAY
Fly under the West Gate Bridge, over the Bolte's towers and up the Yarra past Docklands and the Melbourne Star. Ships at Swanson Dock and Station Pier, St Kilda pier and Luna Park, Brighton's bathing boxes, Williamstown's timeball tower.

GEELONG AND BEYOND
Avalon, the You Yangs, Werribee Mansion, Geelong's waterfront and Corio Bay.

A LIVING CITY
Trains on their real lines, traffic on the left, yachts and ferries on the bay. At night the CBD lights up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar by Albert Park Lake, the skyline out of the doors. Repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
Melbourne and Avalon approaches, a hop to Essendon, the Bayside Run, under the West Gate, a night landing, a city tour, Geelong, an Avalon scramble, Melbourne by night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
